checks.first_failure: IhkAtomic extraction start boundary is non-unique because the selected prefix also matches IhkAtomic64

findings: The IhkAtomic begin marker also matches IhkAtomic64; adding the opening brace makes the boundary unique while retaining both definitions.
The Rust fixture moves a mutable slice before later indexing it and stabilized feature declarations may fail under -D warnings.
Rust and C emit incompatible measured schemas and Rust classifies retained rings inconsistently with its expected rows.
Recovery, true two-head isolation, actual begin/enqueue/finish source reuse and complete metadata preservation remain missing.
Several malformed-state rows are printed rather than derived from constructed state; the C model still hardcodes rejection rows.
Trait probes accept any compiler failure and are confounded by an unused-import warning.
Callback borrow or capacity failures are silently discarded rather than observed and rejected.
structural_improvements_only: Production definitions and list helpers are now extracted and the Rust fixture is appended verbatim.
The mutant now releases a valid prefix before encountering the invalid node.
No-argument output creation and success-path command/hash recording were expanded.
